lineas: Day 15. Toni becomes a babysitter. He owes 265 dollars. And he has never babysat anything. Not even a plant.
The parents pay twenty dollars for the night. Toni gets three kids.
Rule number one: no sugar. Rule number two: bedtime at nine.
The kids find the sugar in the first four minutes.
By nine o'clock they are on the ceiling. Almost literally. One is on top of the wardrobe.
Toni tries a bedtime story. He tells them his own business plans. All three fall asleep.
The parents come back at midnight. The house is a disaster. But the kids are asleep.
They pay twenty and tip ten. Toni spends five on cleaning supplies. Toni owes 240 dollars.
What business should he try tomorrow? Comment it, and Toni will do it.
